info.title: Aqar Rent API
info.description:
Aqar Rent (إيجار مباشر) — a broker-free rental marketplace for Egypt.
Owners pay a flat 500 EGP / 7 days per listing; the platform never takes
commission and never handles rent or deposits.

* Arabic-first (RTL), English secondary.
* Standard error body: `{code, message, details}`; cursor pagination.

post.description:
Gateway callbacks (Paymob / Mock). Verifies the signature, dedupes on
gateway_txn_id under a row lock, stores the raw payload and settles the
order. Authentic-but-ignorable events return 200 so gateways do not
retry-storm; bad signature → 401, bad payload → 400.
